text:
Giselle Moreno: hi everyone! i'm giselle, starting today as a devops engineer (she/her). remote from oakland but planning an SF week in 3 weeks. hobbies: hammock napping, collecting Polaroids, and fostering a tiny rescue cat named pickle. excited to meet y'all :) :wave:
Sam: welcome Giselle!! hammock nap champ, noted. :raised_hands: pickle pics when you can, mandatory. we have a "pets of redwood" channel if you want to drop photos.
Rhea: hi giselle  welcome! FYI there's a rooftop hammock hang (informal) sometimes after 6pm on Fridays. super laid-back crowd. also we have a tiny Polaroid exchange shelf in the kitchen for snaps.
Ben (IT): Hey Giselle  badge/email provisioned. Your badge will be at reception after 10am. If you'd like a standing desk or an extra monitor shipped for your Oakland setup, reply here and I'll queue it. Also wanted to flag: we don't hang hammocks from office structural beams; portable stand ok in lounge with approval.
Giselle Moreno: thanks Ben! please queue a monitor shipment. noted on hammock policy  will bring a portable stand if i set up in the lounge.
Luca: welcome!! rooftop hang sounds like my kind of unwind. also snack poll: rosemary crackers vs chili lime chips this week? vote with an emoji. :crackers: :hot_pepper: 
plants-bot: There is a houseplant adoption this Friday at lunch. Current list: spider plant, pothos, baby fern. Reaction to this message to claim.
Giselle Moreno: voting :crackers: and claiming a baby fern if it survives my black-thumb trial. also attaching a Polaroid of Pickle for science. :camera:
welcome-bot: Onboarding checklist updated for Giselle Moreno  badge_assigned, welcome_message_sent.
Sam: :thumbsup: see you at the rooftop hammock hang, and for the record i back the rosemary crackers. also Pickle is an instant star.
Rhea: adding you to the SF-week calendar invite so you get the casual meetups. bring a camera and an appetite. :)
